landing-fold-eyebrow: Now in open beta · free while we build
landing-fold-standfirst: One <mark>calendar</mark> across every profile, one <mark>draft</mark> adapted per audience, and an <mark>approval trail</mark> on every post.
landing-commitment-statement:
Nothing publishes
without a name on it.
landing-commitment-body: Publishing and approving are separate, per-action permissions — not one blanket role. Every post keeps the history of who drafted it, who approved it and who published it. And each client profile stays isolated from the others, so context never bleeds between accounts.
landing-tour-tab-calendar-description: See planned and queued content across every brand and region in a single shared view — no separate calendar per client account.
landing-tour-tab-composer-description: Write the post once. Reuse the copy and the assets across profiles, changing only what a channel or a brand voice actually requires.
landing-tour-tab-approvals-description: Approval and publish permissions are explicit at every step, so a client always knows who signed off before anything goes live.
landing-tour-tab-profiles-description: Every client profile keeps its own membership and permissions, so context never bleeds from one account into another.
landing-tour-tab-dashboards-description: A weekly, cross-profile summary of pacing, execution, and the work still waiting on approval.
landing-claim-traceability-details: post keeps draft, approval, and publish traceability.
landing-bento-title: Built for the work that does not fit in one inbox
landing-bento-shared-queue-body: Drafts enter a single workflow and move visibly across review stages. No silent edits from outside the process.
landing-bento-role-access-body: Draft, approve, and publish permissions stay scoped by profile and are easy to adjust per team need.
landing-bento-teams-agencies-body: Invite colleagues quickly, keep client profiles isolated, and keep context stable across handovers.
landing-bento-inhouse-operations-body: Keep weekly planning close to your core team while still allowing delegated approvals and publishing.
landing-bento-small-studios-body: Use a lightweight flow before you scale teams or tools, with room to grow into heavier operations.
landing-pricing-title: One price per team, not per brand
landing-pricing-studio-description: Two brand profiles, three people, one shared calendar.
landing-pricing-agency-description: Ten profiles, per-action permissions and approvals, full history.
landing-timeline-title: A short, predictable path through the planned trial
landing-trial-plan-note: The free trial is planned before general availability. Today, PublyApp is free while in beta.
landing-timeline-step-1-description: Create your first profile and invite your team members.
landing-timeline-step-2-description: Start weekly planning with approvals in place and shared queue habits established.
landing-timeline-step-3-description: Keep the same rhythm with less back-and-forth and cleaner handoffs.
landing-faq-title: Questions teams ask at first look
landing-faq-0-question: Can I run this alongside another scheduling tool?
landing-faq-0-answer: Yes. Teams usually run both for a short period while they move workflows. You can keep an external tool connected while shifting teams over profile by profile.
landing-faq-1-question: What does onboarding require before I can draft?
landing-faq-1-answer: You need one project team and one profile, then your workflow settings and approvals can be added in the same screen.
landing-faq-2-answer: Approvals are first-class actions in the post lifecycle. Every change keeps context and the history of who approved it.
landing-faq-3-question: What support is available if I get stuck?
landing-faq-3-answer: Today, PublyApp is free while in beta, but no trial support flow is active yet. A free trial is planned before general availability; its support terms have not been published.
landing-closing-title: Put your publishing team in one shared workflow
landing-closing-description: One plan. One calendar. One set of approvals. Today, PublyApp is free while in beta; a lightweight free trial is planned before general availability.
landing-customer-logos-title: Trusted by agencies and in-house teams publishing across hundreds of profiles
